name: Base36alternatesubstitution

description_json.name: Base36AlternateSubstitution
description_json.idea: A simple, highly reliable substitution cipher that maps each letter of the alphabet to a unique alphanumeric character from a fixed, reversed alphanumeric sequence. This breaks standard NLP pattern matching while remaining extremely easy for language models to process accurately. The mapping is symmetric and case-insensitive (all letters are converted to lowercase, and non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged).
description_json.encrypt_rules: Convert the input string to lowercase. For each character: if it is a lowercase letter (a-z), replace it with its corresponding character from the fixed mapping. The mapping is: a->z, b->y, c->x, d->w, e->v, f->u, g->t, h->s, i->r, j->q, k->p, l->o, m->n, n->m, o->l, p->k, q->j, r->i, s->h, t->g, u->f, v->e, w->d, x->c, y->b, z->a. Non-alphabetic characters (spaces, punctuation, digits) remain completely unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules: For each character in the ciphertext: if it is a lowercase letter (a-z), replace it with its corresponding character from the same symmetric mapping (z->a, y->b, etc.). Non-alphabetic characters remain completely unchanged.
